entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Gabon.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento al menos 6 meses posterior a la fecha de llegada a Gabón.
entry.quote: that is at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Gabon.

entry.en: You must have a visa to enter Gabon.
entry.es: Debes tener una visa para entrar a Gabón.
entry.quote: You must have a visa to enter Gabon.

entry.en: The most reliable way to get a visa is through the Gabon High Commission in the UK.
entry.es: La forma más fiable de obtener la visa es a través del Alto Comisionado de Gabón en el Reino Unido.
entry.quote: The most reliable way to get a visa is through the High Commission in the UK.

entry.en: For tourist travel you must provide a hotel booking or a letter from your hotel confirming your stay.
entry.es: Para viajes turísticos debes presentar una reserva de hotel o una carta del hotel que confirme tu estadía.
entry.quote: For tourist travel, you must provide a hotel booking or letter from your hotel confirming your stay.

entry.en: You must have a certificate proving a yellow fever vaccination to enter Gabon.
entry.es: Debes tener un certificado que acredite la vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla para entrar a Gabón.
entry.quote: To enter Gabon, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination.

entry.es: La tarifa de la visa suele ser de 70 a 85 euros.
entry.quote: The fee for a visa to enter the country is typically €70-85.

safety.en: There have been incidents of robbery, armed attacks and rape in Gabon.
safety.es: Ha habido incidentes de robo, ataques armados y violación en Gabón.
safety.quote: There have been incidents of robbery, armed attacks and rape in Gabon.

safety.en: Protests and unrest can occur without warning and the situation could change quickly.
safety.es: Pueden producirse protestas y disturbios sin previo aviso y la situación podría cambiar rápidamente.
safety.quote: Protests and unrest can occur without warning and the situation could change quickly.

safety.en: Tensions after the August 2023 military coup resulted in some tourists being held and questioned about their reasons for travelling to Gabon.
safety.es: Las tensiones tras el golpe militar de agosto de 2023 llevaron a que algunos turistas fueran retenidos e interrogados sobre sus motivos para viajar a Gabón.
safety.quote: Political and security tensions following the August 2023 military coup resulted in some tourists being held and questioned about their reasons for travelling to Gabon.

safety.en: There are reports of violent assaults and robberies on taxi passengers; use licensed taxis and ask to book one exclusively.
safety.es: Hay informes de agresiones violentas y robos a pasajeros de taxi; se deben usar taxis con licencia y pedir uno de uso exclusivo.
safety.quote: There have been reports of violent assaults and robberies on taxi passengers. Use licensed taxis, and ask to book the taxi exclusively so it does not pick up other passengers.

safety.en: There have been reports of carjackings in Libreville.
safety.es: Ha habido informes de robos de vehículos con violencia en Libreville.
safety.quote: There have been reports of carjackings in Libreville.

safety.en: Travelling by road at night should be avoided because many roads are unlit.
safety.es: Se debe evitar viajar por carretera de noche porque muchas vías no tienen alumbrado.
safety.quote: Avoid travelling by road at night as many roads are unlit.

health.en: Medical facilities are limited, particularly in rural areas, so adequate travel health insurance is needed.
health.es: Los servicios médicos son limitados, sobre todo en zonas rurales, por lo que se necesita un seguro médico de viaje adecuado.
health.quote: Medical facilities are limited, particularly in rural areas. Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance

health.en: Malaria is common, so visitors should take malaria pills and a mosquito net.
health.es: La malaria es común, por lo que los visitantes deben llevar pastillas contra la malaria y un mosquitero.
health.quote: Malaria is common, so visitors should take malaria pills and a mosquito net when travelling in Gabon.

health.en: HIV prevalence in Gabon is estimated at 3.8% of adults, compared with around 0.2% in the UK.
health.es: Se estima que la prevalencia del VIH en Gabón es del 3,8% de los adultos, frente a cerca del 0,2% en el Reino Unido.
health.quote: the prevalence percentage is estimated at 3.8% of the adult population compared with the prevalence percentage in adults in the UK of around 0.2%.

help.en: The ambulance number is 117, with SOS Médecins on 1300, 0174 or 0880 depending on network, and operators may only speak French.
help.es: El número de ambulancia es 117, con SOS Médecins al 1300, 0174 u 0880 según la red, y los operadores quizá solo hablen francés.
help.quote: Ambulance: 117. Depending on your mobile network, call: 1300, 0174 or 0880 for SOS Médecins. Operators may only speak French.

help.en: None of the emergency numbers are guaranteed to be reliable, and help can be limited in some hard-to-reach places.
help.es: No se garantiza que ninguno de los números de emergencia sea fiable, y la ayuda puede ser limitada en algunos lugares de difícil acceso.
help.quote: None of these numbers are guaranteed to be reliable. Emergency help can be limited in some places that are hard to reach

help.en: FCDO in London can be called on 020 7008 5000, 24 hours, for urgent help if something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Se puede llamar al FCDO en Londres al 020 7008 5000, las 24 horas, para ayuda urgente si algo le ha pasado a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote:
You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

Telephone: 020 7008 5000 (24 hours)

getting_in.en: Libreville International Airport (LBV) is well connected to other African cities.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional de Libreville (LBV) está bien conectado con otras ciudades africanas.
getting_in.quote: Libreville International Airport (LBV IATA). is well-connected to other African cities.

getting_in.en: The only direct flights from outside Africa are from Paris (Air France) and Istanbul (Turkish Airlines).
getting_in.es: Los únicos vuelos directos desde fuera de África son desde París (Air France) y Estambul (Turkish Airlines).
getting_in.quote: The only destinations outside of Africa one can fly from directly are Paris (Air France) and Istanbul (Turkish Airlines).

getting_in.en: There are several border crossings, though the roads are not good and a 4x4 is recommended.
getting_in.es: Hay varios pasos fronterizos, aunque las carreteras no son buenas y se recomienda un 4x4.
getting_in.quote: There are several border crossings, though the roads are not good and a 4x4 is recommended.

getting_around.en: Outside cities the easiest way to get around is by bus, typically 6- or 9-seater cars but sometimes minibuses.
getting_around.es: Fuera de las ciudades lo más fácil es el autobús, normalmente autos de 6 o 9 plazas y a veces minibuses.
getting_around.quote: The easiest way to get around outside of cities is by bus (typically 6- or 9-seater cars, but sometimes minibuses).

getting_around.en: Within cities taxis are plentiful and very cheap, and no fare should be more than FCFA 5000 for one person.
getting_around.es: Dentro de las ciudades los taxis abundan y son muy baratos, y ninguna tarifa debería superar los 5000 FCFA por persona.
getting_around.quote: Within cities, taxis are plentiful and are very cheap. No fare should be more than FCFA 5000 for one person.

getting_around.es: Los precios de los taxis suelen duplicarse después de las 21:00.

getting_around.en: The Trans-Gabon railway runs from Owendo to Franceville, takes 12-18 hours and is often delayed.
getting_around.es: El ferrocarril Transgabonés va de Owendo a Franceville, tarda de 12 a 18 horas y a menudo se retrasa.
getting_around.quote: The Trans-Gabon railway goes from Owendo to Franceville. The trip takes 12-18 hours, and is often delayed.

getting_around.en: There are less than 800km of tarred roads in Gabon, some in bad condition.
getting_around.es: Hay menos de 800 km de carreteras asfaltadas en Gabón, algunas en mal estado.
getting_around.quote: There are less than 800km of tarred roads in Gabon - some of them in a bad condition.

getting_around.en: Boat travel is available all along the coast and dozens of miles up the Ogooue river to Lambarene.
getting_around.es: Hay transporte en barco a lo largo de toda la costa y decenas de millas río arriba por el Ogooué hasta Lambaréné.
getting_around.quote: Boat travel is available all along the coast of Gabon and dozens of miles up the Ogooue river to Lambarene.

money.en: The currency is the Central African CFA franc (FCFA, ISO code XAF).
money.es: La moneda es el franco CFA de África Central (FCFA, código ISO XAF).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the Central African CFA franc, denoted FCFA (ISO currency code: XAF).

money.en: The Central and West African CFA francs are both fixed at 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.
money.es: Los francos CFA de África Central y Occidental están fijados en 1 euro = 655,957 francos CFA.
money.quote: Both currencies are fixed at a rate of 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.

money.en: All Ecobank ATMs in Gabon take Mastercard and Visa cards for cash withdrawal.
money.es: Todos los cajeros Ecobank de Gabón aceptan tarjetas Mastercard y Visa para retirar efectivo.
money.quote: All Ecobank ATMs in Gabon take Mastercard and Visa card for cash withdrawal.

money.en: Credit cards are not widely accepted except at hotels.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito no se aceptan ampliamente salvo en hoteles.
money.quote: Credit cards are not widely accepted except at hotels.

etiquette.en: The people are generally very friendly, respectful and helpful to visitors.
etiquette.es: La gente suele ser muy amable, respetuosa y servicial con los visitantes.
etiquette.quote: The people are generally very friendly, respectful and helpful to visitors.
